question: ______ won the bronze medal in the women's 10 m air rifle event at the ISSF World Cup 2023 in Cairo, Egypt.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tilottama Sen.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tilottama Sen is an Indian shooter who has represented India in various international shooting events.**
 
• **The ISSF World Cup **is a prestigious shooting tournament organized by the International Shooting Sport Federation, where shooters from different countries compete in various events.
 
• Tilottama Sen **won a bronze medal in the women's 10m Air Rifle at ISSF World Cup Cairo in Egypt on 22 February 2023**.
 
 
• She won the second bronze for India.
 
 
 
• Great Britain’s Seonaid Mcintosh won gold and Switzerland’s Olympic Champion Nina Christen came second to win silver.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Shreyasi Singh, **another option mentioned, is also an Indian shooter who has won several medals in international shooting events, including a gold medal in the women's double trap event at the 2018 Commonwealth Games.
 
• **Sift Kaur Samra and Nivetha Paramanantham,** the other two options mentioned, are also shooters who have represented their respective countries in international shooting events.
